newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Petro in share issue - sources.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petro in share issue - sources.

text.p: Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd is issuing 150 million new shares at HK$2.28 each to its parent to raise an estimated HK$342 million, market sources said on Monday.
State-owned parent China Petrochemical Corp will place the same number of existing shares with institutional investors at the same price.
The price represents about a seven percent discount to the shares' last closing price of HK$2.45 on Friday. Trading in the shares was suspended on Monday morning pending an announcement.
"The response is good and allocation is underway," a source close to the deal said.
Peregrine Capital Ltd is said to be involved in the placement.
